title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Statement, Suspension and Termination Terms
content:
The statement and program-administration terms of the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** are the same for all six tiers (Residential Mandatory Amount, Residential Gap, Residential Replacement Cost, Manufactured Home, Commercial Building, Commercial Building and Contents).

| Term | Meaning | Value on every tier |
|---|---|---|
| Statement cycle | Frequency of the lender's premium statement | Monthly |
| Statement due | Days after the statement date the statement is due | 30 calendar days |
| Suspension threshold | Days past due of the oldest unpaid statement after which new placements are suspended | 60 calendar days |
| Reinstatement | Whether placements resume once every past-due statement is paid | Yes |
| Termination notice | Days of written notice for the lender to terminate the master program | 90 calendar days |
| Run-off | Whether certificates issued before termination run to their expiration | Yes |

## Reading the terms
- The 30-day due period runs from the statement date; the 60-day suspension threshold runs from the due date of the oldest unpaid statement.
- The 90-day notice period runs from Tidemark's receipt of the lender's signed termination notice.
